description: Coastal Data System – Near real time storm tide data is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. Actual, predicted and residual water level data, measured by storm tide gauges at coastal locations along the Queensland coast. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. Its tags are GovHack 2019, The Science Sandpit, emergency, science, storm. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, txt. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
